page_title: EMP 2-1 PAR | Empoli v Parma 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Ismael Konate (Empoli) produced a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Zion Suzuki thwarted him with a fabulous save.
90+2' Hernani (Parma) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' Mattia Viti (Empoli) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
88' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) inside the box.
86' 2 - 1 Goal! Ismael Konate plays a short, square pass into the path of Faustino Anjorin (Empoli), who bends a shot straight into the top right corner to make it 2:1. Fabulous goal!
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) will be replaced by Ola Solbakken.
84' Substitution. Ismael Konate on for Liam Henderson (Empoli).

84' Luca Marianucci (Empoli) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.

82' Hernani (Parma) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with a powerful strike from a long-range free kick. His effort, however, goes way wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
80' Parma couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach (Empoli) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
77' Christian Chivu prepares a substitution. Ange-Yoan Bonny is replaced by Botond Balogh (Parma).
77' A substitution has been made. Liberato Cacace goes off and Junior Sambia (Empoli) comes on.
76' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:1.

73' 1 - 1 Goal! Milan Djuric (Parma) peels away from his marker to meet the resulting free kick from Hernani, and he steers a powerful header from near the penalty spot low inside the right post. What a finish that is - 1:1!
73' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
71' Alberto Grassi comes off the pitch to be replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli).
69' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Fabbri interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
67' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' Simon Sohm goes off the pitch and Hernani (Parma) comes on.
65' Christian Chivu has decided to substitute Mateo Pellegrino and he is replaced by Milan Djuric (Parma).
64' Simon Sohm (Parma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach, who smothers the ball.
63' 9:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
59' Substitution. Drissa Camara (Parma) replaces Jacob Ondrejka.
59' Antoine Hainaut (Parma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

58' The ball rebounds out to Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
58' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
57' Liam Henderson (Empoli) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. Empoli force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
54' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. Parma have a free kick.
51' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 44:56.
48' Parma enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Michael Fabbri has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+4' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
43' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
40' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
39' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Parma, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
37' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.

33' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) hits the free kick from the edge of the box, but can't find the target. His shot flies miles wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.

31' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) must have known he would be sent off for this foul, but he had to stop the opponent at all costs. Michael Fabbri shows him a second yellow card and the game has ended for him. Empoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
31' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul and Michael Fabbri immediately signals a free kick.
29' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
27' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle and it's Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
24' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball.
22' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee. Empoli win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.

21' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) climbs highest in the middle of the box after a cross from the wing, but sends a good looking header narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
19' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
17' Great teamplay by Parma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
14' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Zion Suzuki was alert and made a comfortable save.

11' 1 - 0 Liam Henderson produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the top of the net. What a brilliant finish. 1:0.
11' Liam Henderson (Empoli) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
11' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
8' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
5' The Parma players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' The foul by Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
